items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I worked with him in Ellington's band and when I worked with him there I'll never forget him.

ctx.x: I worked with him in Ellington's band and when I worked with him there I'll never forget him. He just worked there a little while while I was there. He come in, you know, in Wendell's place. When Wendell left the band, he come in and worked in there a little while and he didn't want to travel too much. He came back to New York. And Duke thought
that he was the greatest bass player ever lived.
